palette: imperial yellow-brown ground + pale edict panels + vermillion seal stamps + dark ink annotations + gold frame borders
typography: ink headings on edict panels, dark frame label tabs with gold left bar, gold chips for categories, vermillion stamps for distinctions, thin ink underline for terms
composition: four edict panels arranged as a two-by-two grid; the distinctions strip anchors the bottom
surface: flat imperial ground with faint scroll hairlines, edict panels with hairline weathered borders and corner seal dots, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: panels unroll one by one, category chips ink in, the distinction stamps land once
transition: a scroll roller sweeps and the court clears for the next edict
